title_zh: 莫高窟:沙漠中的佛教艺术宝库
title_en: Beautiful Places in China (9/20): The Mogao Caves, a Treasure House of Buddhist Art in the Desert
note_en: 得以 is a formal word meaning "was able to, got the chance to," used when something becomes possible thanks to particular conditions: 正因为…气候干燥少雨，这些脆弱的壁画才得以保存下来 "It is precisely because the climate is dry... that these fragile murals have survived." It often pairs with 正因为…才, as again in Xiao Zhou's closing thought 正是因为沙漠的沉寂，这些脆弱的壁画才得以留存到今天, and sounds more literary than 能. English usually just says "managed to" or "were able to" — or leaves it out entirely.
